authorization: Project owner explicitly selected the disclosed AI-reviewed protocol amendment in this chat.
model_id_note: Exact serving model identifier is not independently recorded; do not invent one.
blinding: Not independent or fully blind: the assistant has prior study context, condition identities and benchmark results.
timing: Post-results methodological amendment, recorded before filling the 150 new audit labels; not original preregistration.

rubric.clone: Both fragments implement the same functionality, regardless of syntax.
rubric.not_clone: Different functionality, or one implements only a small part of the other.
rubric.unsure: Insufficient context or unresolved functional-equivalence ambiguity; do not force a binary label.

review_requirements: Keep the existing pairs and IDs; no outcome-driven resampling.
Read both fragments and record a pair-specific functional rationale for every judgment.
Record reviewer_type=ai and this amendment ID with each completed sheet and scored result.
Freeze labels before scoring and before joining the audit key.
Preserve the original blank pack and quarantined invalid evidence.
Retain key-to-triples, complete-label and score-bound outcome checks.

scoring.point_rate: clone / 50; unsure contributes zero to the point rate, unchanged from the original instrument
scoring.interval: Wilson 95% interval; sampling uncertainty only, not AI-label accuracy or reviewer bias
scoring.decision_bands: Retain the recorded C4/C5/C6 numerical bands; report consistency or inconsistency with them, not independent human confirmation.

reporting_requirements: Every C4/C5/C6 audit rate in the table, report and paper must say AI-reviewed, not independently human-validated.
Do not describe the completed AI judgments as human, independent, fully blind, or originally preregistered.
Use the rates as descriptive evidence; do not certify a mechanism or confirmed control solely from the AI audit.
Disclose shared reviewer errors, prior outcome knowledge, missing inter-rater agreement and absent human validation.
